about: Extraction bench — cross-engine comparison on real pages.
Scoring is FACT RECALL, not byte count: byte counts reward nav chrome and punish
clean extraction (that is how 'this tool returns 1.7x more' became a misleading
headline in the fastCRW evaluation). Each case may declare must_contain facts,
each of which is a distinctive content string that should survive extraction.
expect semantics:
ok            must extract real content (offline/HTTP-only is expected to suffice)
needs_render  content exists only after JS execution; a non-rendering engine is
not penalised for missing it, a rendering engine is scored on facts
fail          must fail loudly and cleanly (no styled-404 garbage, no consent page)
policy        the assertion is about behaving correctly, e.g. honouring robots.txt
facts_source records where the golden strings came from, because a fixture whose
truth was read off a rendering engine cannot be used to prove that engine right:
raw-html      served HTML (ground truth for non-JS pages)
raw-html+jsonld  served HTML, incl. content that only exists inside ld+json
rendered      a rendered view (weaker truth; flagged per case)
none          no facts yet
Run --validate to check every declared fact against the ground-truth HTML; any
fact the fixture gets wrong is reported as a FIXTURE ERROR rather than silently
distorting an engine comparison.

cases.axis: negative control: rendering does NOT help when data is in a JSON payload
cases.why: Included as a counter-case. crw --js almost doubles the text here (1,120 -> 1,914 chars) and takes 20 s, but the events are in the __NEXT_DATA__ payload rather than the DOM, so no events appear. Rendering is not a universal fix; reading the payload is a different fix.

cases.axis: webx's own opt-in fallback, end to end
cases.why: Same page as t-spa-never-renders-rendered but a different question: webx alone fails here (63 chars), and this case asserts it reaches the facts when given --fallback-engine=crw. Ground truth is the same captured render, so the fixture cannot pretend webx solved it without the flag.
